_meta: Per-show minimum scored reviews for showing a Critic Score, overriding the market minimum (and the T3-only extra). Owner-approved exceptions only; each entry names who approved it and why. Read by scoreGateArg() in src/config/scoring.ts and scripts/lib/should-hide-reviews.js (BRO-7750). Standing rule (owner, 2026-11-23, BRO-8163): every special and every Broadway / West End run of 56 days or less shows a Critic Score at 3 scored reviews with no entry needed (scripts/lib/score-gate-rule.js, mirrored in scoreGateArg). An entry in shows wins over the rule. keptMarketMinimum.<id> {approvedBy, reason} opts a show out of the rule so it keeps the market minimum.
